known_issues.summary: Arabic PDF raw extraction/search/copy behavior is reader-dependent and is not lossless.
Unvocalized PNG/outlined SVG only; PDF and combining marks are refused because the original font has fsType=2 and no GPOS. No Jali or logo composition engine.
Manual labeled-cell studies only. No arbitrary-text conversion, packed composition engine or independent calligrapher review.
